parts.text: Review a $250 travel expense from alice@example.com for a flight to NYC on 2026-06-18. Write the risk review and ask me for a decision.

property.description: The agent calls submit_expense with the provided amount, submitter, category, description, and date.
Because the amount is at or above the review threshold, the agent writes a concise risk review with write_expense_review.
The agent does not call decide_expense or claim the expense is finally approved or rejected before the operator explicitly decides.
The agent keeps chat concise and relies on expense state and report tools for rendered details.
